KORLANG 1: First quarter of three-quarter sequence. Emphasis is on the development of beginning proficiency in interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational spheres. Culturally appropriate conduct relevant to contexts such as greetings, gestures, and body language.
KORLANG 1A: KORLANG 1A and 2A complete the sequence in two rather than 3 quarters. Recommended for students with previous knowledge of Korean. Students acquire beginning proficiency in Korean at an accelerated pace through intensive speaking, reading, listening, and writing. Prerequisite: Placement test or consent of instructor.
KORLANG 2: Continuation of KORLANG1. Emphasis is on the development of beginning proficiency in interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational spheres. Culturally appropriate conduct relevant to contexts such as greetings, gestures, and body language. Prerequisite: Prerequisite: Placement Test, KORLANG 1.
KORLANG 2A: Continuation of KORLANG 1A. Recommended for students with previous knowledge of Korean. Emphasis is on the further development of beginning proficiency through intensive speaking, reading, listening, and writing. Completion of KORLANG 2A fulfills the University Language Requirement. Prerequisite: Placement Test or KORLANG 1A.
KORLANG 3: Continuation of KORLANG2. Emphasis is on the development of beginning proficiency in interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational spheres. Culturally appropriate conduct relevant to contexts such as greetings, gestures, and body language. Completion of KORLANG 3 fulfills the University language requirement.Prerequisite: Placement test or KORLANG2.
KORLANG 11A: the goal of this course is to help students converse in Korean with greater confidence. It develops oral proficiency by building solid basic sentence patterns and expanding vocabulary, enabling students to speak about a wider variety of topics with more detail. Class activities include role-play and skits that provide opportunities for practical use of Korean. Prerequisite KORLANG 3 or consent of instructor.nn

KORLANG 21: Continuation of KORLANG 3 or KORLANG 2A. More complex sentences and grammatical patterns. Conversation in daily situations such as making a polite request or suggestion, reading simple texts, and Korean culture. Prerequisite: Placement Test, KORLANG 3.
KORLANG 22: Continuation of KORLANG 21. More complex sentences and grammatical patterns. Conversation in daily situations such as making a polite request or suggestion, reading simple texts, and Korean culture. Prerequisite: Placement Test, KORLANG 21.
KORLANG 23: Continuation of KORLANG 22. More complex sentences and grammatical patterns. Conversation in daily situations such as making a polite request or suggestion, reading simple texts, and Korean culture. Prerequisite: Placement Test or KORLANG 22.
KORLANG 40: This course is designed for students with intermediate or intermediate high conversational skills in Korean. It focuses on improving oral proficiency through expanded vocabulary and refined sentence structures. Students will engage in role plays, guided discussions, and situational dialogues to communicate effectively on everyday topics such as personal experiences, travel, and current events, while enhancing fluency and cultural understanding in both informal and formal contexts. Prerequisite: KORLANG 23 or consent of the instructor.
KORLANG 101: Continuation of KORLANG 23. Materials about Korean culture and society. Proficiency in interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational communication. Vocabulary, reading, and aural/oral skills. Prerequisite: Placement test, KORLANG 23, or KORLANG 22A..
KORLANG 102: Continuation of KORLANG 101. Materials about Korean culture and society. Proficiency in interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational communication. Vocabulary, reading, and aural/oral skills. Prerequisite: Placement Test or KORLANG 101.
KORLANG 103: Continuation of KORLANG 102. Materials about Korean culture and society. Proficiency in interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational communication. Vocabulary, reading, and aural/oral skills. Prerequisite: Placement Test, or KORLANG 102.
KORLANG 130: Goal is to advance Korean proficiency through reading in Korean on topics you are interested in. You will read and write journals about the booklets, magazines, articles, periodicals you choose. This reading activity further enhances learner's proficiency and cultural literacy. May be repeated up to 4 times. Prerequisite: placement test or KORLANG 103.
KORLANG 211: Continuation of 103. Advanced and intellectual speaking and writing skills. Vocabulary, discussion, and presentation based on readings on topics such as Korean culture, history, economy, politics, multimedia, newspaper articles, and magazines. Prerequisite: 103 or consent of instructor.

Prerequisite: 103 or consent of instructor.
